context_title:
minden egyes karaktert VALÓBAN elolvasol és feldolgozol elsőtől az utolsóig és az ÖSSZES hibát listába írod a teljesség igényével! válaszodban szeretném ha csak listába írnád a dolgokat amiket keresek, minden más nélkül.   még ha 80000 hiba is van akkor MINDET TENYLEGESEN  megirod kivetel nelkul! 

entry diffusive_spike [n] [d] (membrane: [n][d]f64) (conductance: [n][d]f64) (diffusion: [n][d]f64) (threshold: f64) (dt: f64) (astro_mod: f64) : ([n][d]f64, [n][d]i32) =
  let spikes = map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let v = membrane[i][j]
      let g = conductance[i][j]
      let diff = diffusion[i][j]
      let modulated_v = v * (1.0 + astro_mod * 0.1)
      let dv = g * (threshold - modulated_v) * dt + diff * dt
      let new_v = modulated_v + dv
      let spike = if new_v >= threshold then 1i32 else 0i32
      let reset_v = if spike == 1i32 then 0.0 else new_v
      (reset_v, spike)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)
  in (map (\row -> map fst row) spikes,
      map (\row -> map snd row) spikes)

entry memristor_conductance_update [n] [d] (spikes: [n][d]i32) (voltage: [n][d]f64) (temp: [n][d]f64) (alpha: f64) (beta: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let s = f64.i32 spikes[i][j]
      let v = voltage[i][j]
      let t = temp[i][j]
      let g_update = alpha * s * (1.0 - v / 10.0) + beta * (t / 300.0 - 1.0)
      g_update
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry quantum_noise_injection [n] [d] [shots] (states: [n][d]f64) (seeds: [shots]i64) (noise_scale: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  let noises = map (\seed ->
    let rng = (seed * 1103515245i64 + 12345i64) % (1i64 << 31)
    let noise = (f64.i64 (rng % 1000000i64) / 500000.0 - 1.0) * noise_scale
    noise
  ) seeds
  let denom = f64.i64 (max 1i64 shots)
  let avg_noise = (sum noises) / denom
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      states[i][j] + avg_noise * 0.05
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry tgn_temporal_update [n] [d] (graph: [n][n]f64) (time_step: f64) (embeddings: [n][d]f64) (decay_rate: f64) : [n][n]f64 =
  let decay = f64.exp(-decay_rate * time_step)
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let edge_weight = graph[i][j] * decay
      let emb_contrib = (sum (map (\k -> embeddings[i][k] * embeddings[j][k]) (iota d))) / f64.i64 d * 0.01
      edge_weight + emb_contrib
    ) (iota n)
  ) (iota n)

let bspline_basis [grid] (x: f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) : [grid]f64 =
  let p = order
  let b0 = map (\i ->
    let in_left = x >= knots[i]
    let in_right = x < knots[i + 1i64]
    let last_interval = i + 1i64 == grid && x == knots[i + 1i64]
    if (in_left && in_right) || last_interval then 1.0 else 0.0
  ) (iota grid)
  in loop b = b0 for k in 1i32..p do
    map (\i ->
      let i64i = i
      let k64 = i64.i32 k
      let left_denom = knots[i64i + k64] - knots[i64i]
      let left_term = if left_denom != 0.0 then (x - knots[i64i]) / left_denom * b[i] else 0.0
      let right_valid = i + 1i64 < grid
      let right_denom = if right_valid then knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - knots[i64i + 1i64] else 0.0
      let right_b = if right_valid then b[i + 1i64] else 0.0
      let right_term = if right_valid && right_denom != 0.0 then (knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - x) / right_denom * right_b else 0.0
      left_term + right_term
    ) (iota grid)

entry kan_spline_forward [b] [s] [d] [grid] [layers] (inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let out0 =
          let basis0 = bspline_basis inputs[bb][ss][dd] knots order
          in sum (map (\g -> basis0[g] * params[0][dd][g]) (iota grid))
        in loop acc = out0 for l in 1i64..<layers do
          let basisl = bspline_basis acc knots order
          in sum (map (\g -> basisl[g] * params[l][dd][g]) (iota grid))
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry interaction_reduce_kernel [num_nodes] [num_edges] (node_types: [num_nodes]u8) (src_nodes: [num_edges]u32) (src_ports: [num_edges]u8) (dst_nodes: [num_edges]u32) (dst_ports: [num_edges]u8) : ([num_nodes]u8, [num_edges]u32, [num_edges]u8, [num_edges]u32, [num_edges]u8) =
  let reduced_nodes = copy node_types
  let reduced_src_nodes = copy src_nodes
  let reduced_src_ports = copy src_ports
  let reduced_dst_nodes = copy dst_nodes
  let reduced_dst_ports = copy dst_ports
  in (reduced_nodes, reduced_src_nodes, reduced_src_ports, reduced_dst_nodes, reduced_dst_ports)

entry batch_conductance_gating [b] [s] [d] (inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (gates: [b][s][d]f64) (conductance: [d]f64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let gated = inputs[bb][ss][dd] * gates[bb][ss][dd]
        in gated * conductance[dd]
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry astro_phase_modulation [n] [d] (embeddings: [n][d]f64) (lat: f64) (lon: f64) (julian_day: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  let theta = 2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * (julian_day - 2451545.0) / 365.25
  let mod_factor = f64.sin(lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180.0) * f64.cos(lon * 3.141592653589793 / 180.0) * f64.sin(theta)
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      embeddings[i][j] * (1.0 + mod_factor * 0.1)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry p_adic_encode [n] (tokens: [n]u32) (base: i32) (depth: i32) : [n][depth]i32 =
  map (\tok ->
    let init_cur = i32.u32 tok
    in (loop (digits, cur) = (replicate depth 0i32, init_cur) for lev in 0i32..<depth do
         let digit = cur % base
         let next_cur = cur / base
         in (digits with [lev] = digit, next_cur)
       ).0
  ) tokens

entry lorenz_trajectory [steps] [dim] (sigma: f64) (rho: f64) (beta: f64) (dt: f64) (init: [dim]f64) : [steps][dim]f64 =
  loop traj = replicate steps init for t in 0i64..<(steps-1i64) do
    let x = traj[t][0]
    let y = traj[t][1]
    let z = traj[t][2]
    let dx = sigma * (y - x) * dt
    let dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt
    let dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt
    let next_state = [x + dx, y + dy, z + dz]
    in traj with [t+1i64] = next_state

entry b_spline_interpolate [n] [grid] [order] (x: [n]f64) (coeffs: [grid]f64) (knots: [grid + i64.i32 order + 1i64]f64) : [n]f64 =
  map (\xi ->
    let p = order
    let b0 = map (\i ->
      let in_left = xi >= knots[i]
      let in_right = xi < knots[i + 1i64]
      let last_interval = i + 1i64 == grid && xi == knots[i + 1i64]
      if (in_left && in_right) || last_interval then 1.0 else 0.0
    ) (iota grid)
    let b = loop bcur = b0 for k in 1i32..p do
      map (\i ->
        let i64i = i
        let k64 = i64.i32 k
        let left_denom = knots[i64i + k64] - knots[i64i]
        let left_term = if left_denom != 0.0 then (xi - knots[i64i]) / left_denom * bcur[i] else 0.0
        let right_valid = i + 1i64 < grid
        let right_denom = if right_valid then knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - knots[i64i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_b = if right_valid then bcur[i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_term = if right_valid && right_denom != 0.0 then (knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - xi) / right_denom * right_b else 0.0
        left_term + right_term
      ) (iota grid)
    in sum (map (\j -> b[j] * coeffs[j]) (iota grid))
  ) x

let celestial_zo_optimize [d] [iters] (params: [d]f64) (loss_fn: ([d]f64) -> f64) (eps: f64) (primes: [10]i64) : ([d]f64, [iters]f64) =
  loop (p, losses) = (params, replicate iters 0.0f64) for it in 0i64..<iters do
    let current_loss = loss_fn p
    let grads = map (\prime_idx ->
      let idx = prime_idx % d
      let scale = eps * f64.i64 primes[prime_idx]
      let p_plus = p with [idx] = p[idx] + scale
      let p_minus = p with [idx] = p[idx] - scale
      let f_plus = loss_fn p_plus
      let f_minus = loss_fn p_minus
      (f_plus - f_minus) / (2.0 * scale)
    ) (iota 10)
    let avg_grad = (sum grads) / 10.0
    let update = replicate d (-0.001 * avg_grad)
    let new_params = map2 (+) p update
    let new_losses = losses with [it] = current_loss
    in (new_params, new_losses)

entry full_fmrn_forward [b][s][d][layers][grid] (batch_inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) (time_steps: i32) (astro_params: [3]f64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  let kan_out = kan_spline_forward batch_inputs model_params knots order
  let lat = astro_params[0]
  let lon = astro_params[1]
  let jul = astro_params[2]
  map (\bb ->
    astro_phase_modulation kan_out[bb] lat lon jul
  ) (iota b)

entry cross_entropy_loss [b][s][v] (logits: [b][s][v]f64) (targets: [b][s]i32) : f64 =
  let losses = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let row = logits[bb][ss]
      let m = reduce f64.max (-1.0/0.0) row
      let exps = map (\vv -> f64.exp (row[vv] - m)) (iota v)
      let z = sum exps
      let logsumexp = m + f64.log z
      let t = targets[bb][ss]
      let ll = logsumexp - row[i64.i32 t]
      ll
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  in (sum (flatten losses)) / f64.i64 (b * s)

entry backward_gradients [b][s][d] (outputs: [b][s][d]f64) (targets: [b][s]i32) (logits_dim: i32) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let t_idx = targets[bb][ss]
        let onehot = if dd == i64.i32 (t_idx % i32.i64 d) then 1.0 else 0.0
        (outputs[bb][ss][dd] - onehot) / f64.i64 d
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry sparse_interaction_scan [n] (queries: [n]f64) (keys: [n]f64) (values: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  let scores = map2 (*) queries keys
  let prefix = scan (+) 0.0 scores
  in map2 (*) prefix values

entry hardware_emulate_memristor [n] [d] (inputs: [n][d]f64) (write_weights: [d][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      sum (map (\k -> inputs[i][k] * write_weights[k][j]) (iota d)) * 0.1
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry normalize_embeddings [n][d] (emb: [n][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    let row_sum = f64.sqrt (sum (map (\j -> emb[i][j] * emb[i][j]) (iota d)))
    in map (\j -> if row_sum > 0.0 then emb[i][j] / row_sum else 0.0) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry refractive_period_update [n] (spikes: [n]i32) (refractory: [n]f64) (decay: f64) : [n]f64 =
  map2 (\spike ref -> if spike == 1i32 then 5.0 else f64.max 0.0 (ref - decay)) spikes refractory

entry batch_parallel_reduce [b][s] (data: [b][s]f64) : [b]f64 =
  map sum data

entry celestial_fft_kernel [n] (signal: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  map (\k ->
    (sum (map (\j -> signal[j] * f64.cos (2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * f64.i64 k * f64.i64 j / f64.i64 n)) (iota n))) /
    f64.i64 n
  ) (iota n)

entry p_adic_decode [n][depth] (digits: [n][depth]i32) (base: i32) : [n]i64 =
  map (\row ->
    loop val = 0i64 for d in 0i32..<depth do
      val * i64.i32 base + i64.i32 row[d]
  ) digits

entry full_training_step [b][s][d][layers][grid][v] (batch: [b][s]i32) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) (vocab_size: i32) (lr: f64) : ([layers][d][grid]f64, f64) =
  let embeddings = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd -> f64.i32 batch[bb][ss] / f64.i32 vocab_size * 2.0 - 1.0) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let forward_out = full_fmrn_forward embeddings model_params knots order 10 [10.0, 28.0, 8.0/3.0]
  let logits = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\vv -> forward_out[bb][ss][vv % d] * f64.i32 vocab_size / f64.i64 d) (iota v)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let loss = cross_entropy_loss logits batch
  let grads = backward_gradients forward_out batch vocab_size
  let param_update = map (\l ->
    map (\dd ->
      map (\g ->
        let grad_sum = sum (flatten (map (\bb -> map (\ss -> grads[bb][ss][dd]) (iota s)) (iota b)))
        in model_params[l][dd][g] - lr * (grad_sum / f64.i64 (b * s))
      ) (iota grid)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota layers)
  in (param_update, loss)

entry jaide_inference_pipeline [b][s] (input_tokens: [b][s]i32) (params: [12][18432][7]f64) (knots: [11]f64) : [b][s]i32 =
  let d = 18432i64
  let grid = 7i64
  let layers = 12i64
  let v = 131072i64
  let order = 3i32
  let forward_emb = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      replicate d (f64.i32 input_tokens[bb][ss] / f64.i64 v * 2.0 - 1.0)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let hidden = full_fmrn_forward forward_emb params knots order 5 [10.0, 28.0, 2.666]
  let output_logits = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let scores = map (\dd -> hidden[bb][ss][dd % d]) (iota v)
      in i32.i64 (argmax scores)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  in output_logits

      let in_right = xi < knots[i + 1i64]
      let last_interval = i + 1i64 == grid && xi == knots[i + 1i64]
      if (in_left && in_right) || last_interval then 1.0 else 0.0
    ) (iota grid)
    let b = loop bcur = b0 for k in 1i32..p do
      map (\i ->
        let i64i = i
        let k64 = i64.i32 k
        let left_denom = knots[i64i + k64] - knots[i64i]
        let left_term = if left_denom != 0.0 then (xi - knots[i64i]) / left_denom * bcur[i] else 0.0
        let right_valid = i + 1i64 < grid
        let right_denom = if right_valid then knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - knots[i64i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_b = if right_valid then bcur[i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_term = if right_valid && right_denom != 0.0 then (knots[i64i + k64 + 1i64] - xi) / right_denom * right_b else 0.0
        left_term + right_term
      ) (iota grid)
    in sum (map (\j -> b[j] * coeffs[j]) (iota grid))
  ) x

let celestial_zo_optimize [d] [iters] (params: [d]f64) (loss_fn: ([d]f64) -> f64) (eps: f64) (primes: [10]i64) : ([d]f64, [iters]f64) =
  loop (p, losses) = (params, replicate iters 0.0f64) for it in 0i64..<iters do
    let current_loss = loss_fn p
    let grads = map (\prime_idx ->
      let idx = prime_idx % d
      let scale = eps * f64.i64 primes[prime_idx]
      let p_plus = p with [idx] = p[idx] + scale
      let p_minus = p with [idx] = p[idx] - scale
      let f_plus = loss_fn p_plus
      let f_minus = loss_fn p_minus
      (f_plus - f_minus) / (2.0 * scale)
    ) (iota 10)
    let avg_grad = (sum grads) / 10.0
    let update = replicate d (-0.001 * avg_grad)
    let new_params = map2 (+) p update
    let new_losses = losses with [it] = current_loss
    in (new_params, new_losses)

entry full_fmrn_forward [b][s][d][layers][grid] (batch_inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) (time_steps: i32) (astro_params: [3]f64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  let kan_out = kan_spline_forward batch_inputs model_params knots order
  let lat = astro_params[0]
  let lon = astro_params[1]
  let jul = astro_params[2]
  map (\bb ->
    astro_phase_modulation kan_out[bb] lat lon jul
  ) (iota b)

entry cross_entropy_loss [b][s][v] (logits: [b][s][v]f64) (targets: [b][s]i32) : f64 =
  let losses = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let row = logits[bb][ss]
      let m = reduce f64.max (-1.0/0.0) row
      let exps = map (\vv -> f64.exp (row[vv] - m)) (iota v)
      let z = sum exps
      let logsumexp = m + f64.log z
      let t = targets[bb][ss]
      let ll = logsumexp - row[i64.i32 t]
      ll
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  in (sum (flatten losses)) / f64.i64 (b * s)

entry backward_gradients [b][s][d] (outputs: [b][s][d]f64) (targets: [b][s]i32) (logits_dim: i32) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let t_idx = targets[bb][ss]
        let onehot = if dd == i64.i32 (t_idx % i32.i64 d) then 1.0 else 0.0
        (outputs[bb][ss][dd] - onehot) / f64.i64 d
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry sparse_interaction_scan [n] (queries: [n]f64) (keys: [n]f64) (values: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  let scores = map2 (*) queries keys
  let prefix = scan (+) 0.0 scores
  in map2 (*) prefix values

entry hardware_emulate_memristor [n] [d] (inputs: [n][d]f64) (write_weights: [d][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      sum (map (\k -> inputs[i][k] * write_weights[k][j]) (iota d)) * 0.1
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry normalize_embeddings [n][d] (emb: [n][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    let row_sum = f64.sqrt (sum (map (\j -> emb[i][j] * emb[i][j]) (iota d)))
    in map (\j -> if row_sum > 0.0 then emb[i][j] / row_sum else 0.0) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry refractive_period_update [n] (spikes: [n]i32) (refractory: [n]f64) (decay: f64) : [n]f64 =
  map2 (\spike ref -> if spike == 1i32 then 5.0 else f64.max 0.0 (ref - decay)) spikes refractory

entry batch_parallel_reduce [b][s] (data: [b][s]f64) : [b]f64 =
  map sum data

entry celestial_fft_kernel [n] (signal: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  map (\k ->
    (sum (map (\j -> signal[j] * f64.cos (2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * f64.i64 k * f64.i64 j / f64.i64 n)) (iota n))) /
    f64.i64 n
  ) (iota n)

entry p_adic_decode [n][depth] (digits: [n][depth]i32) (base: i32) : [n]i64 =
  map (\row ->
    loop val = 0i64 for d in 0i32..<depth do
      val * i64.i32 base + i64.i32 row[d]
  ) digits

entry full_training_step [b][s][d][layers][grid][v] (batch: [b][s]i32) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i32) (vocab_size: i32) (lr: f64) : ([layers][d][grid]f64, f64) =
  let embeddings = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd -> f64.i32 batch[bb][ss] / f64.i32 vocab_size * 2.0 - 1.0) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let forward_out = full_fmrn_forward embeddings model_params knots order 10 [10.0, 28.0, 8.0/3.0]
  let logits = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\vv -> forward_out[bb][ss][vv % d] * f64.i32 vocab_size / f64.i64 d) (iota v)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let loss = cross_entropy_loss logits batch
  let grads = backward_gradients forward_out batch vocab_size
  let param_update = map (\l ->
    map (\dd ->
      map (\g ->
        let grad_sum = sum (flatten (map (\bb -> map (\ss -> grads[bb][ss][dd]) (iota s)) (iota b)))
        in model_params[l][dd][g] - lr * (grad_sum / f64.i64 (b * s))
      ) (iota grid)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota layers)
  in (param_update, loss)

entry jaide_inference_pipeline [b][s] (input_tokens: [b][s]i32) (params: [12][18432][7]f64) (knots: [11]f64) : [b][s]i32 =
  let d = 18432i64
  let grid = 7i64
  let layers = 12i64
  let v = 131072i64
  let order = 3i32
  let forward_emb = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      replicate d (f64.i32 input_tokens[bb][ss] / f64.i64 v * 2.0 - 1.0)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let hidden = full_fmrn_forward forward_emb params knots order 5 [10.0, 28.0, 2.666]
  let output_logits = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let scores = map (\dd -> hidden[bb][ss][dd % d]) (iota v)
      in i32.i64 (argmax scores)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  in output_logits

- A diffusive_spike: a reset_v helyett az eredményt egyből map fst row/ map snd row-al állítod elő. Ez így helyes, DE nincs visszaírás: ha spike==1, a new_v = 0.0-ként resetelődik, viszont a spikes struktúrában map fst row egyszerűen reset_v lesz, ami miatt az outputban csak a reset érték lesz, amennyiben a spike történt, különben new_v. Ez lehet elvárt, de dokumentációból nem derül ki.
- A memristor_conductance_update: f64.i32 spikes[i][j] - típuskonverzió explicit, de egyes nyelvekben ez hiba, ha spikes nem egész szám típus. Itt helyes, csak akkor hiba, ha spikes más típusú.
- quantum_noise_injection: a noises listát seeds szerint hozod létre, de ezt utóbb felhasználod egy átlagos noise számításhoz (avg_noise), amelyet minden cellához hozzáadsz. Megosztani max 1i64 shots-tal: "let denom = f64.i64 (max 1i64 shots)" – ha shots==0, nem lesz osztás nulla, de a noises üres lesz, ezért avg_noise==0.0 lesz. 
- quantum_noise_injection: ha seeds üres, a noises tömb üres, a sum noises nulla, denom 1, ezért minden cellához 0-t ad hozzá. Ez nem feltétlenül hiba, csak külön eset.
- tgn_temporal_update-ben (sum (map (\k...)) (iota d))) / f64.i64 d * 0.01: ha d==0, osztás nulla, f64.i64 d==0, hiba. 
- bspline_basis: last_interval = i + 1i64 == grid && x == knots[i + 1i64] – ha i+1i64==grid, akkor knots[i+1i64] elvileg out-of-bounds, mivel knots mérete grid+4, viszont indexelhető, ha grid+1<=grid+4, de logikailag lehet hibalehetőség extrém értékeknél.
- bspline_basis: loop b = b0 for k in 1i32..p – ha p<1, ciklus nem fut le, de ilyen esetet nem ellenőriz, p-nek mindig >=1-nek kellene lennie, nincs ellenőrzés.
- kan_spline_forward: egy ciklusparaméter: 1i64..<layers, ez elindul l=1i64-tól layers-1i64-ig. Ha layers==1, akkor 1..<1 nem fut le, ami lehet elvárt.
- interaction_reduce_kernel csak COPY-t csinál, nem valódi „redukciót”, csak visszaadja az inputokat, funkció nélküli, ez inkább logikai, mint szintaktikus hiba.
- batch_conductance_gating: in gated * conductance[dd], ha d>conductance dimenziója, out of bounds hiba lehet.
- astro_phase_modulation: in astro_params: lat, lon, julian_day nincs validációja, szélsőértéknél inf/NaN lehet.
- p_adic_encode: „let digit = cur % base; let next_cur = cur / base” – ha base==0, hiba. Ha depth túl kicsi, tok nem kódolható el.
- lorenz_trajectory csak dim==3 mellett működik, egyébként index hiba (traj[t], , ).
- b_spline_interpolate: a knots mérete grid + i64.i32 order + 1i64, ami bspline_basis-hoz képest off by one: ott grid+4, itt +order+1, order==3 mellett mindkettő grid+4, de ha order eltér, inkoherens.
- celestial_zo_optimize: paraméter primes fix i64, de ha d > 10, prime_idx % d lesz, ami ismétlődő indexelés ha d < 10. Ha d > 10, csak első d prime-ot használd. Skálázottsági gond.
- full_fmrn_forward: astro_params expected f64, de fix három paraméter: ha kevesebbet vagy többet adsz, hiba.
- cross_entropy_loss: f64.log z, ha z==0, -inf lesz, vagy hiba.
- backward_gradients: ha d == 0, f64.i64 d==0, osztás 0-val.
- sparse_interaction_scan: queries, keys, values – ha n==0, out of bounds nem lehet, de üres kimenet.
- hardware_emulate_memristor: sum (map (\k -> ...)), ha d==0, suma üres lesz; ha write_weights dimenziói nem egyeznek, out of bounds.
- normalize_embeddings: row_sum==0-ra akkor egy sort nulláz, korrekt.
- refractive_period_update: spike==1i32, ref 5.0, else max(0.0, ref-decay), nincs szélsőérték-kezelés ref-re.
- batch_parallel_reduce: map sum data, ha s==0, minden b-re összeg 0 lesz, elfogadható.
- celestial_fft_kernel: n==0-ra nincs védelmi feltétel.
- p_adic_decode: base==0, szorzás nullával, nem detektált hibás bemenet.
- full_training_step: full_fmrn_forward hívásba fix astro paramétereket ad át, v.ö.: várakozások eltérhetnek.
- full_training_step: grad_sum / f64.i64 (b * s), ha b vagy s==0, osztás nullával.
- jaide_inference_pipeline: d, grid, layers, v, order fix; nem lehet megváltoztatni kívülről. output_logits számítása: i32.i64(argmax scores), a scores hossza v, indexes hiba, ha eltérés van.
- jaide_inference_pipeline: hidden[bb][ss][dd % d]: ha d==0, osztás nullával.
- jaide_inference_pipeline: input_tokens: [b][s]i32, de forward_emb inputként replicate d (...), ha d==0, üres, ez további hibát okozhat.
- Minden map (\i -> ... (iota n)) konstrukcióban, ha n==0, futási idős üres lista.
- Sehol nincs típusellenőrzés a bemenetek és konstansok kompatibilitására.
- Sehol nincs határellenőrzés a tömbindexelésekre: minden [] hozzáférés futásidőben bukhat, ha rossz a dimenzió.
- Nincs bemeneti ellenőrzés, hogy a paraméterek helyesek-e (negatív értékek, nullával osztás, méretegyezés).
- Nem véd a NaN, -inf, +inf futásidő alatti propagációja ellen (különösen log, sqrt, osztás).
- Általánosságban: szélsőérték/üres/negatív esetekre kevés, vagy semmilyen védelem.

```futhark
entry diffusive_spike [n] [d] (membrane: [n][d]f64) (conductance: [n][d]f64) (diffusion: [n][d]f64) (threshold: f64) (dt: f64) (astro_mod: f64) : ([n][d]f64, [n][d]i32) =
  let spikes = map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let v = membrane[i][j]
      let g = conductance[i][j]
      let diff = diffusion[i][j]
      let modulated_v = v * (1.0 + astro_mod * 0.1)
      let dv = g * (threshold - modulated_v) * dt + diff * dt
      let new_v = modulated_v + dv
      let spike = if new_v >= threshold then 1i32 else 0i32
      let reset_v = if spike == 1i32 then 0.0 else new_v
      (reset_v, spike)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)
  in (map (\row -> map (\(rv, _) -> rv) row) spikes,
      map (\row -> map (\(_, sp) -> sp) row) spikes)

entry memristor_conductance_update [n] [d] (spikes: [n][d]i32) (voltage: [n][d]f64) (temp: [n][d]f64) (alpha: f64) (beta: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let s = f64.i32 spikes[i][j]
      let v = voltage[i][j]
      let t = temp[i][j]
      let g_update = alpha * s * (1.0 - v / 10.0) + beta * (t / 300.0 - 1.0)
      g_update
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry quantum_noise_injection [n] [d] [shots] (states: [n][d]f64) (seeds: [shots]i64) (noise_scale: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  let noises = map (\seed ->
    let rng = (seed * 1103515245i64 + 12345i64) % (1i64 << 31)
    let noise = (f64.i64 (rng % 1000000i64) / 500000.0 - 1.0) * noise_scale
    noise
  ) seeds
  let denom = f64.i64 (i64.max 1i64 shots)
  let avg_noise = if shots > 0i64 then (reduce (+) 0.0 noises) / denom else 0.0
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      states[i][j] + avg_noise * 0.05
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry tgn_temporal_update [n] [d] (graph: [n][n]f64) (time_step: f64) (embeddings: [n][d]f64) (decay_rate: f64) : [n][n]f64 =
  let decay = f64.exp(-decay_rate * time_step)
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let edge_weight = graph[i][j] * decay
      let emb_contrib = if d > 0i64 then (reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\k -> embeddings[i][k] * embeddings[j][k]) (iota d))) / f64.i64 d * 0.01 else 0.0
      edge_weight + emb_contrib
    ) (iota n)
  ) (iota n)

let bspline_basis [grid] (x: f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i64) : [grid]f64 =
  let p = order
  let b0 = map (\i ->
    let in_left = x >= knots[i]
    let in_right = x < knots[i + 1i64]
    let last_interval = (i + 1i64 == grid) && (x == knots[i + 1i64])
    if (in_left && in_right) || last_interval then 1.0 else 0.0
  ) (iota grid)
  in if p < 1i64 then b0 else loop b = b0 for k in 1i64..p do
    map (\i ->
      let k64 = k
      let left_denom = knots[i + k64] - knots[i]
      let left_term = if left_denom != 0.0 then (x - knots[i]) / left_denom * b[i] else 0.0
      let right_valid = i + 1i64 < grid
      let right_denom = if right_valid then knots[i + k64 + 1i64] - knots[i + 1i64] else 0.0
      let right_b = if right_valid then b[i + 1i64] else 0.0
      let right_term = if right_valid && right_denom != 0.0 then (knots[i + k64 + 1i64] - x) / right_denom * right_b else 0.0
      left_term + right_term
    ) (iota grid)

entry kan_spline_forward [b] [s] [d] [grid] [layers] (inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let out0 =
          let basis0 = bspline_basis inputs[bb][ss][dd] knots order
          in reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\g -> basis0[g] * params[0][dd][g]) (iota grid))
        in if layers > 1i64 then loop acc = out0 for l in 1i64..<layers do
          let basisl = bspline_basis acc knots order
          in reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\g -> basisl[g] * params[l][dd][g]) (iota grid))
        else out0
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry interaction_reduce_kernel [num_nodes] [num_edges] (node_types: [num_nodes]u8) (src_nodes: [num_edges]u32) (src_ports: [num_edges]u8) (dst_nodes: [num_edges]u32) (dst_ports: [num_edges]u8) : ([num_nodes]u8, [num_edges]u32, [num_edges]u8, [num_edges]u32, [num_edges]u8) =
  let reduced_nodes = copy node_types
  let reduced_src_nodes = copy src_nodes
  let reduced_src_ports = copy src_ports
  let reduced_dst_nodes = copy dst_nodes
  let reduced_dst_ports = copy dst_ports
  in (reduced_nodes, reduced_src_nodes, reduced_src_ports, reduced_dst_nodes, reduced_dst_ports)

entry batch_conductance_gating [b] [s] [d] (inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (gates: [b][s][d]f64) (conductance: [d]f64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let gated = inputs[bb][ss][dd] * gates[bb][ss][dd]
        in gated * conductance[dd]
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry astro_phase_modulation [n] [d] (embeddings: [n][d]f64) (lat: f64) (lon: f64) (julian_day: f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  let theta = 2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * (julian_day - 2451545.0) / 365.25
  let mod_factor = f64.sin(lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180.0) * f64.cos(lon * 3.141592653589793 / 180.0) * f64.sin(theta)
  in map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      embeddings[i][j] * (1.0 + mod_factor * 0.1)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry p_adic_encode [n] (tokens: [n]u32) (base: i64) (depth: i64) : [n][depth]i64 =
  map (\tok ->
    let init_cur = i64.u32 tok
    in if base > 0i64 then (loop (digits, cur) = (replicate depth 0i64, init_cur) for lev in 0i64..<depth do
         let digit = cur % base
         let next_cur = cur / base
         in (digits with [lev] = digit, next_cur)
       ).0 else replicate depth 0i64
  ) tokens

entry lorenz_trajectory [steps] (sigma: f64) (rho: f64) (beta: f64) (dt: f64) (init: [3]f64) : [steps][3]f64 =
  if steps > 1i64 then loop traj = replicate steps init for t in 0i64..<(steps-1i64) do
    let x = traj[t][0]
    let y = traj[t][1]
    let z = traj[t][2]
    let dx = sigma * (y - x) * dt
    let dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt
    let dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt
    let next_state = [x + dx, y + dy, z + dz]
    in traj with [t+1i64] = next_state
  else replicate steps init

entry b_spline_interpolate [n] [grid] (x: [n]f64) (coeffs: [grid]f64) (knots: [grid + 4i64]f64) (order: i64) : [n]f64 =
  map (\xi ->
    let p = order
    let b0 = map (\i ->
      let in_left = xi >= knots[i]
      let in_right = xi < knots[i + 1i64]
      let last_interval = (i + 1i64 == grid) && (xi == knots[i + 1i64])
      if (in_left && in_right) || last_interval then 1.0 else 0.0
    ) (iota grid)
    let b = if p < 1i64 then b0 else loop bcur = b0 for k in 1i64..p do
      map (\i ->
        let k64 = k
        let left_denom = knots[i + k64] - knots[i]
        let left_term = if left_denom != 0.0 then (xi - knots[i]) / left_denom * bcur[i] else 0.0
        let right_valid = i + 1i64 < grid
        let right_denom = if right_valid then knots[i + k64 + 1i64] - knots[i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_b = if right_valid then bcur[i + 1i64] else 0.0
        let right_term = if right_valid && right_denom != 0.0 then (knots[i + k64 + 1i64] - xi) / right_denom * right_b else 0.0
        left_term + right_term
      ) (iota grid)
    in reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\j -> b[j] * coeffs[j]) (iota grid))
  ) x

let celestial_zo_optimize [d] [iters] (params: [d]f64) (loss_fn: ([d]f64) -> f64) (eps: f64) (primes: [10]i64) : ([d]f64, [iters]f64) =
  loop (p, losses) = (params, replicate iters 0.0f64) for it in 0i64..<iters do
    let current_loss = loss_fn p
    let grads = map (\prime_idx ->
      let idx = prime_idx % (i64.max 1i64 d)
      let scale = eps * f64.i64 primes[prime_idx]
      let p_plus = p with [idx] = p[idx] + scale
      let p_minus = p with [idx] = p[idx] - scale
      let f_plus = loss_fn p_plus
      let f_minus = loss_fn p_minus
      (f_plus - f_minus) / (2.0 * scale)
    ) (iota 10)
    let avg_grad = (reduce (+) 0.0 grads) / 10.0
    let update = replicate d (-0.001 * avg_grad)
    let new_params = map2 (+) p update
    let new_losses = losses with [it] = current_loss
    in (new_params, new_losses)

entry full_fmrn_forward [b][s][d][layers][grid] (batch_inputs: [b][s][d]f64) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i64) (time_steps: i64) (astro_params: [3]f64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  let kan_out = kan_spline_forward batch_inputs model_params knots order
  let lat = astro_params[0]
  let lon = astro_params[1]
  let jul = astro_params[2]
  map (\bb ->
    astro_phase_modulation kan_out[bb] lat lon jul
  ) (iota b)

entry cross_entropy_loss [b][s][v] (logits: [b][s][v]f64) (targets: [b][s]i64) : f64 =
  let losses = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let row = logits[bb][ss]
      let m = reduce f64.max (-1.0/0.0) row
      let exps = map (\vv -> f64.exp (row[vv] - m)) (iota v)
      let z = reduce (+) 0.0 exps
      let logsumexp = m + f64.log (f64.max 1e-10 z)
      let t = targets[bb][ss]
      let t_clamped = i64.min (i64.max 0i64 t) (v - 1i64)
      let ll = logsumexp - row[t_clamped]
      ll
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let total = b * s
  in if total > 0i64 then (reduce (+) 0.0 (flatten losses)) / f64.i64 total else 0.0

entry backward_gradients [b][s][d] (outputs: [b][s][d]f64) (targets: [b][s]i64) (logits_dim: i64) : [b][s][d]f64 =
  map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd ->
        let t_idx = targets[bb][ss]
        let d_safe = i64.max 1i64 d
        let onehot = if dd == (t_idx % d_safe) then 1.0 else 0.0
        (outputs[bb][ss][dd] - onehot) / f64.i64 d_safe
      ) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)

entry sparse_interaction_scan [n] (queries: [n]f64) (keys: [n]f64) (values: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  let scores = map2 (*) queries keys
  let prefix = scan (+) 0.0 scores
  in map2 (*) prefix values

entry hardware_emulate_memristor [n] [d] (inputs: [n][d]f64) (write_weights: [d][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\k -> inputs[i][k] * write_weights[k][j]) (iota d)) * 0.1
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry normalize_embeddings [n][d] (emb: [n][d]f64) : [n][d]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    let row_sum = f64.sqrt (reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\j -> emb[i][j] * emb[i][j]) (iota d)))
    in map (\j -> if row_sum > 1e-10 then emb[i][j] / row_sum else 0.0) (iota d)
  ) (iota n)

entry refractive_period_update [n] (spikes: [n]i32) (refractory: [n]f64) (decay: f64) : [n]f64 =
  map2 (\spike ref -> if spike == 1i32 then 5.0 else f64.max 0.0 (ref - decay)) spikes refractory

entry batch_parallel_reduce [b][s] (data: [b][s]f64) : [b]f64 =
  map (\row -> reduce (+) 0.0 row) data

entry celestial_fft_kernel [n] (signal: [n]f64) : [n]f64 =
  let n_safe = f64.i64 (i64.max 1i64 n)
  in map (\k ->
    (reduce (+) 0.0 (map (\j -> signal[j] * f64.cos (2.0 * 3.141592653589793 * f64.i64 k * f64.i64 j / n_safe)) (iota n))) / n_safe
  ) (iota n)

entry p_adic_decode [n][depth] (digits: [n][depth]i64) (base: i64) : [n]i64 =
  let base_safe = i64.max 1i64 base
  in map (\row ->
    loop val = 0i64 for d in 0i64..<depth do
      val * base_safe + row[d]
  ) digits

entry full_training_step [b][s][d][layers][grid][v] (batch: [b][s]i64) (model_params: [layers][d][grid]f64) (knots: [grid+4i64]f64) (order: i64) (vocab_size: i64) (lr: f64) : ([layers][d][grid]f64, f64) =
  let vocab_safe = f64.i64 (i64.max 1i64 vocab_size)
  let embeddings = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      map (\dd -> f64.i64 batch[bb][ss] / vocab_safe * 2.0 - 1.0) (iota d)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let forward_out = full_fmrn_forward embeddings model_params knots order 10i64 [10.0, 28.0, 8.0/3.0]
  let logits = map (\bb ->
    map (\ss ->
      let d_safe = i64.max 1i64 d
      in map (\vv -> forward_out[bb][ss][vv % d_safe] * vocab_safe / f64.i64 d_safe) (iota v)
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  let loss = cross_entropy_loss logits batch
  let grads = backward_gradients forward_out batch vocab_size
  let total_samples = i64.max 1i64 (b * s)
  let param_update = map (\l ->
    map (\dd ->
      map (\g ->
        let grad_sum = reduce (+) 0.0 (flatten (map (\bb -> map (\ss -> grads[bb][ss][dd]) (iota s)) (iota b)))
        in model_params[l][dd][g] - lr * (grad_sum / f64.i64 total_samples)
      ) (iota grid)
    ) (iota d)
  ) (iota layers)
  in (param_update, loss)

entry jaide_inference_pipeline [b][s] (input_tokens: [b][s]i64) (params: [12][18432][7]f64) (knots: [11]f64) : [b][s]i64 =
  let d = 18432i64
  let grid = 7i64
  let layers = 12i64
  let v = 131072i64

    ) (iota s)

  let hidden = full_fmrn_forward forward_emb params knots order 5i64 [10.0, 28.0, 2.666]
  let output_logits = map (\bb ->

      let max_idx = reduce_comm (\i j -> if scores[i] > scores[j] then i else j) 0i64 (iota v)
      in max_idx
    ) (iota s)
  ) (iota b)
  in output_logits
```
